name: star-forge
description: A Codex-native software factory that plans, builds with sub-agents, reviews, and proves completion from git facts.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build with sub-agents, review, and prove completion from git facts through the Forge Loop.
interface.longDescription: Star Forge is a Codex-native software factory built on the Forge Loop: plan (Blueprint with acceptance criteria, one approval) -> build (sub-agent builders, coordinator-recorded verify and browser-run evidence) -> review (reviewer agents write findings that feed a fix queue the completion gate consumes) -> done (a predicate computed from git tree state, never a recorded claim). Post-completion edits automatically reopen the project as an amendment. Hooks observe and re-anchor across compaction; they never block, and local hook ledgers are diagnostic rather than trusted completion witnesses. Live collectors supply task-scoped browser, preview, GitHub PR, native, and security proof artifacts. Lessons compound across projects via a global learnings store.
